mstts:express-as.prosody: As we wrap up, I want you to take a breath and just sit with everything you've felt on this journey. If you’ve walked beside these siblings—especially the young woman at the heart of it—you’ve probably felt the ache of longing, the sting of injustice, and the quiet triumph of finally finding your own voice. Their story is a powerful reminder that dignity isn’t something handed to us by the world. It’s our birthright—something we claim, especially in those small, everyday moments when we choose self-respect and courage. Healing? It’s not a finish line you cross. It’s a slow, winding process, and yes, setbacks will happen. But every step counts. Remember, your story—even the painful parts—can become a well of strength. True independence grows from both leaning on yourself and reaching out for community when you need it. And words? They’re more than just sounds. They can turn pain into meaning, into connection—and help you find your place. So, as you step back into your own life, don’t forget: the world might try to tell you what you’re worth, but only you can decide what you carry forward. These lessons aren’t just for a storybook—they’re for those quiet moments when you feel unseen, or wonder if your voice matters. Let the hope and resilience we’ve found here remind you: you’re not alone. Your story is worth telling. And when you find the courage to sing out—no matter how softly, or how uncertain—you make it easier for others to find their song too. The cage may be real, but so is the sky.
